mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0%, it signals a weak labor market that precedes economic recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 returns as the market prices in upcoming improvement.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, correlating with broader economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST rise, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession supply recovery regime (INDPRO growth > 0.5% monthly), increasing industrial production signals improving manufacturing conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth > 0.5%, or Rank IC for regime is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly GDP growth rate (as reported) indicates robust economic expansion, translating to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.2% signals accelerating inflation that triggers expectations of monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.2%, or Rank IC for signal is below -0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal a coordinated economic recovery with accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or Rank IC for interaction is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime (HOUST > 700 thousand units), rising housing starts signal strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 700, or Rank IC for regime is below 0.02.
